hero_background.description: A rack filled with yellow hard hats, representing construction safety and order.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind classes for sections (Hero, About, Products), minimizing Shadcn generic usage for unique marketing layouts. Do not use border-radius (rounded-none everywhere) to maintain the brutalist industrial look.
Implement a custom React Hook or useEffect to listen for the key sequence '1990'.

When '1990' is typed consecutively, toggle a state `isAdminMode`. When true, display a fixed 'Copy HTML' button at the bottom right. Also apply `contentEditable={isAdminMode}` to all text-bearing elements (h1, h2, p, span, etc.).
For the 'Copy HTML' functionality, you can copy `document.documentElement.outerHTML` or a specific wrapper div to the clipboard.
The header should be sticky with a solid background (`bg-zinc-950`) or heavily blurred to ensure text visibility. Include the logo (use max-h-12).
The Hero section must use `hero_background` image with a dark overlay (`bg-zinc-950/80` or `bg-zinc-950/70`) so the white slogan text 'Welcome to a safer future' pops out.

Product section should showcase both the White and Black CAPSTOK side-by-side or stacked, highlighting the price (€16,99), materials, and use-case (hard hats). Do NOT include a shopping cart, just product information.
Sections needed: Hero, Why CAPSTOK (Features: Safety, Order, Craftsmanship), Product Showcase, About Us, Contact, Footer.
Ensure the entire design is responsive (Mobile first) and uses generous padding (`py-24`).
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor icons for features (e.g., HardHat icon, ShieldCheck, Ruler).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="contact-email-link"`).
